entries.acceptance_criterion: Current instructions, implementation paths, saved-project baseline, and all relevant prompts/configuration are mapped.
entries.required_proof: Code references and baseline artifact.
entries.validation_method: Static code audit: traced pipeline call graph and cross-referenced every registered renderer/tool against its production caller; re-read the 6 obstacle call sites against current source.
entries.actual_result: Traced the real end-to-end path (final narration -> EditorialBlueprint -> RevealGraph -> MVP needs/requirements -> candidate library+rights -> evidence-built offers+engines -> direct_film slot assignment -> graphics materialization -> production script compose -> render -> coverage/review) with file:function for every stage, and identified the exact hand-off seam (needs.py:plan_needs, line 252/255) where a Detective Director plan must be substituted for MVP's own independent mvp.needs model call.

entries.acceptance_criterion: Every registered visual tool is traced to its renderer, inputs, production caller, and owner control.
entries.required_proof: Completed capability/reachability matrix.
entries.validation_method: Static code audit: traced pipeline call graph and cross-referenced every registered renderer/tool against its production caller; re-read the 6 obstacle call sites against current source.
entries.actual_result: Completed the capability matrix for all 20 tools plus photos/clips and host segments (22 rows): 21 reachable in production via at least one real offer-builder or shot path, 1 dead (floor_plan: fully implemented renderer registered in registry.py but no caller anywhere ever constructs a floor_plan offer). Only the 8 cinematic engines have an owner UI control (engines-panel.tsx); no other tool (map, boards, timeline, cards, headline, quote, document) is exposed to the owner in the frontend.

entries.acceptance_criterion: Conflicting old selection/validation rules are identified and replaced where required without disabling useful capabilities.
entries.required_proof: Before/after behavior and regression checks.
entries.validation_method: Gated replacement: each of 4 rules changes behavior only when a DetectiveScene exists for the graph (none do in production today); both the new gated behavior and the unchanged ungated behavior are covered by tests.
entries.actual_result: Obstacles 1 (photo/map-before-graphics), 3 (unknown needs question/disputed row), 4 (repetition block), 6 (dated-event-always-wins board card) replaced and tested. Obstacle 2 (engine cap) satisfied by construction (detective-dispatched beats bypass the capping agent call entirely) but not exercised by an engine-kind dispatch test. Obstacles 5 and 7 are explicitly Section F's and H's work respectively, not A3's.
entries.remaining_issue: Obstacle 2 unexercised end-to-end; obstacles 5/7 deferred to Sections F/H by design.

entries.acceptance_criterion: Final language-specific narration is the content reference; valid text spans work without research rows.
entries.required_proof: Text-only fixture with optional metadata absent.
entries.validation_method: tests/test_detective_memory.py::test_claim_question_relation_need_no_fact_or_contradiction_row — pytest against the real db_session fixture (live PostgreSQL, real schema/constraints). That fixture flushes within an open transaction and closes without committing (this suite's existing convention, see tests/test_longform_phase1.py) so rows do not persist past the test process; the migration's tables/columns/constraints were separately confirmed to persist permanently via  + a direct SQL query, see docs/detective_toolkit_section_b_design.md.
entries.actual_result: A claim, question and relation are created and persisted (within the test transaction) purely from narration text spans; zero Fact/Contradiction rows exist in the test at all.

entries.acceptance_criterion: The complete prompt, input wrapper, schema, model/agent configuration, and real call path are connected.
entries.required_proof: Actual map/direct/repair calls and stored outputs.
entries.validation_method: Real map_film and direct_scenes calls against the live configured provider (apimaster/gemini-3.8-flash) on a scratch case; unit tests with a fake provider for the validation/persistence/repair-rejection paths.
entries.actual_result: AgentRun 31711 (map_film) and 31712 (direct_scenes), both completed, real cost recorded in provider_calls (case_id=20). Output validated and persisted into Section B's memory tables plus the new detective_scenes/detective_tool_actions.

entries.acceptance_criterion: Every consequential tool selection follows an investigative aim and records its expected audience benefit.
entries.required_proof: Scene decisions linked to narration and state.
entries.validation_method: Live call inspection: each persisted scene carries aim, why_selected, expected_audience_gain and the content bindings behind its actions, tied to real narration spans.
entries.actual_result: Live scene scn_01_discovery: aim 'introduce the 9mm handgun...', tool detective_board, content_bindings to real claim/relation IDs grounded in the fixture narration — not a template or a photo-filled default.

entries.acceptance_criterion: Question payoffs, meaningful connections, human interest, and breathing room follow the text.
entries.required_proof: Reviewed continuous scene sequence.
entries.validation_method: The one live fixture (3 narration units, 2 beats) is too short to demonstrate a question payoff paying off scenes later, or sustained human-interest/breathing-room pacing across a real act structure.
entries.actual_result: The live call DID open a question (qst_gun_owner, explicit_unresolved) and carry it as an active_thread into scene 2, which is the right shape, but a longer real-passage exercise is needed to prove payoff/pacing over a full sequence rather than a 3-sentence fixture.
entries.remaining_issue: Needs a longer representative or real passage (Section K's job, or a deliberately longer Section C fixture) exercising multiple question-payoff and recovery-beat scenes before this can be called VERIFIED.

entries.acceptance_criterion: Future knowledge does not leak; unsupported certainty, conclusions, or connections are not added.
entries.required_proof: Reveal, attribution, and semantic fixtures plus render inspection.
entries.validation_method: Unit test with a deliberately premature content binding (a claim anchored after the citing scene's own narration position) plus a real live-call code path identical to the one that would catch it.
entries.actual_result: test_map_film_rejects_premature_release_without_persisting confirms the violation is detected and NOTHING is persisted (zero DetectiveScene rows) — the doc's 'no future answers' / 'no invented certainty' requirement enforced before, not after, persistence.
